how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-sort:warrior-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:1498:obj:0: Bring 5 Singed Scales to Uzzek at Far Watch Post in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1498:details:0: As a warrior, one of our most crucial tasks is... protection. We are the shield of the ⟦E2⟧, and we keep our weaker brethren safe. If you are to join in our ranks, then you must prove your mettle to me.
rows.quest:1498:details:1: BGo to Thunder Ridge in ⟦E3⟧, where live the lightning hides and thunder lizards. Hunt the beasts! Show me you are tougher than they! Brave their assaults and bring me a stack of their singed scales as proof.
rows.quest:1498:details:2: BDo this, and then I will teach you.
rows.quest:1498:completion:0: Ah. I see you have defeated the thunder lizards, which proves you are tough. Now I will show you how tough skin and shrewd movements can combine to form an impenetrable wall of defense.
rows.quest:1498:completion:1: BLearn your lesson well, ⟦1⟧. And be ready for future instruction.
rows.quest:1502:obj:0: Speak with Thun'grim Firegaze in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1502:details:0: It is vital that a warrior's weapon is one of quality. And if there is an orc who can craft quality weapons, then that orc is Thun'grim Firegaze. He is a hermit who dwells atop the hills east of the Crossroads.
rows.quest:1502:details:1: BIf you seek a weapon, warrior, then you should seek Thun'grim. To find him, first travel to the Crossroads to the west, then strike east into the hills. His camp is high on a hilltop.
rows.quest:1502:completion:0: My eyes have long dried out from staring into the forge's flame, but some things I can still see. I can see you want something.
rows.quest:1502:completion:1: BAnd if you found your way here, then I can guess what you desire.
rows.quest:1503:obj:0: Bring the Forged Steel Bars to Thun'grim Firegaze in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1503:details:0: I will give you a weapon, ⟦2⟧, but first you must aid me. The Razormanes to the northwest came into my camp a few nights past. They would not meet me in combat, but they know my eyes are bad--a few distracted me with snorts while others stole from me! The cowards!
rows.quest:1503:details:1: BThey took an iron chest, and within it were some forged steel bars. If you can recover them then I will give you the weapon you seek.
rows.quest:1503:details:2: BSearch for the iron box within the quilboar camps, and return with the forged steel bars.
rows.quest:1503:completion:0: You found them! And all the bars are here, which doesn't surprise me. I didn't think the Razormanes would know what to do with fine steel like this.
rows.quest:1503:completion:1: BThank you, ⟦3⟧. Here is your reward. May it serve you well.
rows.quest:1505:obj:0: Speak with Uzzek at Far Watch Post.
rows.quest:1505:details:0: The ⟦E2⟧ honors its warriors because their strength is unquestioned. But the truly great warriors are great students as well.
rows.quest:1505:details:1: BSeek out Uzzek. He is a veteran of many battles and now instructs young warriors in the ways of combat. You will find him south of Far Watch Post, the orc garrison on the border of the ⟦E1⟧ and ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:1505:completion:0: Hello, young one. Here for some instruction, are you?
rows.quest:1638:details:0: You've shown yourself to be a competent warrior, ⟦4⟧. But you're still young and have a lot to learn.
rows.quest:1638:details:1: BSpeak with Harry Burlguard--he's usually in the Pig and Whistle tavern, in the Old Town of ⟦E4⟧. Harry is an old veteran and a good teacher. He can show you a few moves that'll keep you breathing longer.
rows.quest:1638:completion:0: Oh ho! Have a drink with me, ⟦5⟧. You look tough on the outside, but let's see if your gut can handle a few mugs of the Pig and Whistle's strongest!!
rows.quest:1638:completion:1: BOr... were you here for a lesson?
rows.quest:1639:details:0: Yeah, I can teach you. But first I wanna see what moves you have already.
rows.quest:1639:details:1: BSee that drunk over there at the end of the bar? Bartleby? I want you to get his mug.
rows.quest:1639:details:2: BHah, and if you know Bartleby then you know he won't just give it to you.
rows.quest:1639:completion:0: Hello, fancy ⟦6⟧! What's a prissy thing like you doing in the Pig and Whistle? Be careful, or you might break a nail...
rows.quest:1640:obj:0: Beat Bartleby, then talk to him.
rows.quest:1640:details:1: BThe only way you'll get this mug is if you pry it from my cold, dead fingers...
rows.quest:1640:completion:0: You're a lot tougher than you look!
rows.quest:1665:details:0: Ok, here's my mug. Wait! Let me finish what's in it first... there we go.
rows.quest:1665:completion:0: There it is! He sure didn't want to part with it, but you were persuasive. Well done.
rows.quest:1666:details:0: You've learned a few moves, but you could still use a decent weapon. I bet if you spoke with Marshal Haggard he could help you.
rows.quest:1666:details:1: BMarshal Haggard lives in a manor in ⟦E5⟧, at the Eastvale Lumber Camp. He's retired now but he collected a lot of gear during his career.
rows.quest:1666:details:2: BLet him know I sent you, and with luck he'll have a spare weapon to offer.
rows.quest:1666:completion:2: BYou'll have to step a little closer. My eyes aren't what they used to be.
rows.quest:1666:completion:3: BWalking up like that, I thought you were a gnoll!
rows.quest:1667:obj:0: Retrieve Haggard's Badge from Dead-tooth ⟦E6⟧'s camp, and return to Marshal Haggard.
rows.quest:1667:details:0: Burlguard sent you, did he? Yes, I have spare weapons around here, but first I have a task for you...
rows.quest:1667:details:1: BA while ago a Defias villain Dead-tooth ⟦E6⟧ tricked me. It was dark and he was wearing a ⟦E4⟧ tabard and I thought he was Marshal Dughan. He said he needed my old ⟦E4⟧ Marshal's badge and I gave it to him... and then he laughed and ran off before I could catch him!
rows.quest:1667:details:2: BGet back my badge! Dead-tooth ⟦E6⟧ probably has it stowed in his camp to the south.
rows.quest:1667:completion:0: Great, you found it! I feared it was gone forever, used by the Defias to impersonate a ⟦E4⟧ official. Well that won't happen now, thanks to you.
rows.quest:1667:completion:1: BHere are some weapons I used when I was a Marshal. I kept them in great shape--take your pick!
rows.quest:1678:obj:0: Bring Vejrek's Head to Muren Stormpike in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:1678:details:0: If you want to rise in the ranks of the warriors, then you better be tough. I can teach you new moves but before that, prove to me you can handle yourself against real foes.
rows.quest:1678:details:1: BVejrek is the toughest troll you'll find in these parts, and he's who you have to beat. He has a hut in the foothills just south of Frostmane Hold
rows.quest:1678:details:2: BBring me Vejrek's head and I'll know you have mettle.
rows.quest:1678:completion:0: Vejrek sure was an ugly one, eh? Nicely done, ⟦7⟧! You have what it takes, now let's start your lesson...
rows.quest:1678:completion:1: BYou may not know it, but a strong defense is very important to a warrior. It keeps him standing against foes that'd fell others, and that's what your allies need.
rows.quest:1679:details:0: Hello, warrior! You show a lot of promise, but you still need to learn some tricks and Muren Stormpike is just the dwarf to teach you.
rows.quest:1679:details:1: BYou can find Muren at the Hall of ⟦E8⟧ in the Military Ward of ⟦E7⟧. Talk to him when you're ready to learn what it is to be a warrior.
rows.quest:1679:completion:0: Ah, ⟦8⟧. I heard the warriors of ⟦E9⟧ bouncing your name around. I hope you haven't spent all your time in the breweries!
rows.quest:1680:details:0: Now that you've learned some moves, it's time to get you a decent weapon. Speak with Tormus Deepforge. He can make you a weapon I'm sure you'll like.
rows.quest:1680:details:1: BYou'll find Tormus here in ⟦E7⟧, at the Great Forge.
rows.quest:1680:completion:0: Muren sent you, did he? Yes, I can make you a nice weapon... but before I do that, I have a favor to ask of you.
rows.quest:1680:completion:1: BDon't worry. It's plenty dangerous and could mean your death; it's exactly the sort of job a warrior wants.
rows.quest:1681:obj:0: Bring a load of Umbral Ore to Tormus Deepforge in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:1681:details:0: My mentor, Sturgy ⟦E10⟧, had a compound south of Helm's Bed Lake in eastern ⟦E9⟧. There he taught blacksmithing and he was the best.
rows.quest:1681:details:1: BBut one day, one of his students brought him a load of strange ore. Master ⟦E10⟧ called it umbral ore and was eager to work with it, but soon after it arrived... a band of Dark Iron dwarves attacked his compound. They killed everyone!
rows.quest:1681:details:2: BEnter ⟦E10⟧'s compound, ⟦9⟧, and avenge my master's death. And bring me the load of umbral ore that caused it.
rows.quest:1681:completion:1: BI hope you killed a host of Dark Iron dwarves while searching. I fear that ⟦E10⟧'s compound won't be the last place we see them.
rows.quest:1681:completion:2: BBut thank you for the ore, ⟦10⟧. I'm eager to work it and find its properties.
rows.quest:1682:completion:0: Here are some weapons, hot off the anvil and made with the new umbral ore you brought me!
rows.quest:1683:obj:0: Bring the Horn of Vorlus to Elanaria in ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:1683:details:0: Before I can teach you, you must show me your resolve.
rows.quest:1683:details:1: BThe satyr Vorlus Vilehoof has found one of our remote moonwells, southeast of the Ban'ethil Barrow Den. He now splashes within it, defiling its pure waters with his filth.
rows.quest:1683:details:2: BFind Vorlus at the moonwell and destroy him. Bring me his horn as proof and I will begin your advanced training as a warrior.
rows.quest:1683:details:3: BThe path to the moonwell is hidden well, ⟦12⟧, but stay focused and alert and you will find it.
rows.quest:1683:completion:0: Well done, ⟦13⟧. It is good to know Vorlus is defeated and our moonwell cleansed, and it is good to see young warriors eager to keep our beloved ⟦E12⟧ free of corruption.
rows.quest:1683:completion:1: BNow let us begin your training...
rows.quest:1684:details:0: Greetings, warrior. Your skill grows, but there is more to your profession than you may believe. To further progress, you must soon find a teacher.
rows.quest:1684:details:1: BThe warrior Elanaria dwells in ⟦E11⟧, at the Warrior's Terrace. She can instruct you.
rows.quest:1684:completion:0: I bid you greetings, ⟦14⟧. Your name rings loudly in ⟦E11⟧, for you show promise. But we shall soon see if you possess the strength of will to follow the path of the warrior.
rows.quest:1686:obj:0: Bring 8 loads of Elunite Ore and the Medallion of Elura to Elanaria in ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:1686:details:0: You have learned much, ⟦15⟧. Now we will craft you a weapon. A warrior's weapon.
rows.quest:1686:details:1: BTo do this, you must travel to ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:1686:details:2: BLong ago a ship crashed upon the rocks near the Auberdine lighthouse, scattering many crates of elunite ore along the ocean floor.
rows.quest:1686:details:3: BFirst, you must defeat the elunite's guardian, the Shade of Elura. Once the ship's captain, she cursed herself to roam the deeps and protect her shipment for all time. Defeat her, gain her medallion, and gather the crates of lost Elunite.
rows.quest:1686:completion:1: BYou have given the Shade of Elura much deserved peace, and we will use the gathered elunite to make a fine weapon for you.
rows.quest:1692:obj:0: Bring the Case of Elunite to Smith Mathiel.
rows.quest:1692:details:0: I have placed the elunite you gathered into a case. Take it to the blacksmith Mathiel, and he will craft for you an elunite weapon.
rows.quest:1692:details:1: BMathiel is to the south, on the other side of this building.
rows.quest:1692:completion:0: Ah, elunite ore. This is a fine metal to work with, for it is blessed by the goddess ⟦E14⟧ herself. It would be an honor to craft weapons with it.
rows.quest:1693:completion:0: ⟦17⟧, I have crafted these weapons with the elunite you brought to me. Please, take whichever most suits you.
rows.quest:1693:completion:1: BAnd I must thank you. Working with elunite is both an honor and a pleasure.
rows.quest:1698:details:0: Yorus Barleybrew has issued a challenge to all able warriors of the ⟦E15⟧. He waits at the Lakeshire Inn, in Redridge, and pledges a grand reward to anyone able to pass his trial.
rows.quest:1698:completion:0: Hah! So you heard of my challenge, did you?
rows.quest:1698:completion:1: BWell sit down and listen. Have a drink, and savor it... because it might be your last.
rows.quest:1699:obj:0: Enter the Rethban Caverns, reach the first fork, and return to Yorus Barleybrew within the time allowed.
rows.quest:1699:obj:1: BYou must not die and release your spirit.
rows.quest:1699:details:0: I call my challenge the Rethban Gauntlet. To pass the trial, all you must do is enter the Rethban Caverns, to the first fork, then return here. Easy! Except there are a few wrinkles...
rows.quest:1699:details:1: BYou have to return within an hour.
rows.quest:1699:details:2: BThere are whole heaps of Redridge Gnolls in the way.
rows.quest:1699:details:3: BBefore you start, you have to take a swig of my family's signature drink: Barleybrew Scalder!
rows.quest:1699:details:4: BSo what do you say? The Rethban Caverns are in the foothills north of Lakeshire. Are you ready to run the Rethban Gauntlet?
rows.quest:1699:completion:0: You made it! Well done! Three cheers for ⟦18⟧!
rows.quest:1700:obj:0: Bring Furen's Notes to Grimand Elmore.
rows.quest:1700:details:0: I made a copy of my notes on the techniques I learned while making your armor, and I need them sent to Grimand Elmore. He's here in the Dwarven District, in the weapon shop.
rows.quest:1700:details:1: BAnd duck when you give these to him. He's fiercely proud of his skills, and won't like the idea of learning something from me...
rows.quest:1700:completion:0: Furen wrote this? How dare he! Why, I taught him everything he knows! To think he could teach me something is outrageous! Outrageous!
rows.quest:1700:completion:1: BHm... but there is something in his notes that I'd like to try...
rows.quest:1701:obj:0: Gather the materials Furen Longbeard requires, and bring them to him in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:1701:details:0: So I gave you a nice shield, but we don't have to stop there. I know the secrets to make extremely hard mail armor. It's not easy and it takes very rare materials, but if you're willing to do the legwork then I'll make a piece for you.
rows.quest:1701:details:1: BWhat do you say, ⟦19⟧? If you're up for the challenge, then I'll give you a list of what to get and where to get them.
rows.quest:1701:completion:0: You got it all? Amazing! I was afraid those chimaeras would eat you up for sure!
rows.quest:1701:completion:1: BWell let's get started on that armor...
rows.quest:1702:obj:0: Bring the Cask of Scalder to Furen Longbeard.
rows.quest:1702:details:0: You really showed what you were made of when you ran the Rethban Gauntlet, ⟦20⟧. And I'm true to my word. I'll get you the reward I promised...
rows.quest:1702:details:2: BTalk to my friend, Furen Longbeard, in the Dwarven District of ⟦E4⟧. He's the best shieldsmith you'll ever meet, and he owes me a big favor.
rows.quest:1702:details:3: BHere, take Furen this cask of Barleybrew Scalder and ask him for a shield. He'll give you a nice one.
rows.quest:1702:completion:0: Ah, Barleybrew Scalder. Great stuff! So you've been to see Yorus, eh?
rows.quest:1702:completion:1: BI can get you a shield, yes ⟦21⟧! You won't find a better one, and that's no lying!
rows.quest:1703:details:0: I made a copy of my notes on the techniques I learned while making your armor, and need them sent to the blacksmith Mathiel. He lives in ⟦E11⟧ which is quite a long way off, but I'm sure he'll be very grateful to learn what I've learned.
rows.quest:1704:obj:0: Bring Furen's Notes to Klockmort Spannerspan.
rows.quest:1704:details:0: I made a copy of my notes on the techniques I learned while making your armor, and need someone to take them to Klockmort Spannerspan. He's a gnomish blacksmith in ⟦E7⟧ and when he learns what I've learned... I bet he'll pull off his own beard in excitement.
rows.quest:1704:completion:0: Oh my! These notes are amazing! And what's more... they're incredible and they're stupendous and they make my knees go all a-wobbly!
rows.quest:1704:completion:1: BFuren had a breakthrough! A real breakthrough! I can't wait to try out his new technique!
rows.quest:1705:obj:0: Bring 20 vials of Burning Blood and 1 Burning Rock to Grimand Elmore in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:1705:details:0: I hate to admit that Furen might have really found something. But to be sure I'll need to try his techniques on a new piece of armor. If you help me with the materials, ⟦22⟧, then you can have the armor.
rows.quest:1705:details:1: BTo make this armor, I need samples of burning blood and a burning rock.
rows.quest:1705:details:2: BThe only place I know to get them is ⟦E16⟧. The Nightbane worgen based in the Roland's Doom mine have burning blood, and their leader Gutspill will have the rock.
rows.quest:1705:completion:0: Nice work! Now if you'll excuse me, I have some work to do myself...
rows.quest:1708:obj:0: Bring 20 loads of Searing Coral to Klockmort Spannerspan in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:1708:details:0: I want to try Furen Longbeard's new techniques on my own piece of armor. And because you helped Furen and he helped me, you're welcome to the armor after I make it!
rows.quest:1708:details:1: BTo finish the piece, I need a special coral, searing coral. It grows in only one place--along the coast south of Menethil ⟦E17⟧ in the ⟦E18⟧.
rows.quest:1708:details:2: BBring me enough searing coral and I'll get right to work on the armor. And hurry, ⟦24⟧. I'm so eager to get started it's making my toes twist!
rows.quest:1708:completion:0: That's the stuff! Well done! Now let me get this smelted and hammered so I can apply Furen's technique with my own and then we can see what happens!
rows.quest:1708:completion:1: BOh my, oh my! I just know the armor will be very very very tough!
rows.quest:1709:completion:0: Here's your armor, ⟦25⟧. Furen's process worked brilliantly! Perfectly! Marvelously, truly!
rows.quest:1709:completion:1: BYou could run this armor over with a siege engine and it would spring right back into shape!
rows.quest:1710:obj:0: Bring 20 Sunscorched Shells to Mathiel in ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:1710:details:0: My colleague, Furen Longbeard, made a discovery which I am eager to test. I wish to try it on a new armor that I am researching, for I believe Furen's techniques will produce superior results.
rows.quest:1710:details:1: BWill you help me? If you gather what I need to make the armor, then I will make an extra piece for you.
rows.quest:1710:details:2: BI need the sunscorched egg shells of the Highperch Wyverns who dwell at Highperch, in ⟦E19⟧. Search for the shells below their nests, and return to me when you have a sufficient amount.
rows.quest:1710:completion:0: Ah, thank you. These will work splendidly!
rows.quest:1710:completion:1: BI will begin fashioning the armor immediately...
rows.quest:1711:completion:0: I have finished with your piece of armor, and I am quite pleased. Furen's new techniques meshed perfectly with my own and I am sure this armor will prove to be quite resilient.
rows.quest:1711:completion:1: BThank you, ⟦26⟧. And may this serve you well in future battles.
rows.quest:1712:obj:0: Bring the items on Bath'rah's Parchment to Bath'rah the Windwatcher in Alterac.
rows.quest:1712:details:0: I have spent ages watching this site. I watch, so that one day I might see the great Cyclonian fall. But I have not yet found a champion to defeat the wind lord.
rows.quest:1712:details:2: BProve it to me. Gather the items I need to summon Cyclonian, and I will know you are a great warrior. Perhaps then you can defeat him and gain his whirlwind heart.
rows.quest:1712:details:3: BIf so, then I will infuse the heart's power in a weapon, and I will give that weapon to you.
rows.quest:1712:details:4: BHere is a parchment with the items I need.
rows.quest:1712:completion:0: You have gathered the items for my spell, and have shown me your strength and cunning. But the next stage of our quest is even more perilous.
rows.quest:1712:completion:1: BLet us hope your strength does not falter.
rows.quest:1713:obj:0: Bring the ⟦E20⟧ Heart to Bath'rah Windwatcher.
rows.quest:1713:details:0: I am ready to perform the ritual to summon Cyclonian. When he is summoned, you must defeat him and take his whirlwind heart. This I will use to instill a weapon with Cyclonian's power.
rows.quest:1713:details:1: B⟦27⟧, are you ready to face the wind lord?
rows.quest:1713:completion:0: You did it! You defeated Cyclonian and gained the ⟦E20⟧ Heart!
rows.quest:1718:details:0: Your renown as a warrior grows, ⟦28⟧. Now it is time to pit yourself against your peers and see where you stand.
rows.quest:1718:details:1: BThere is an island off the coast of the ⟦E1⟧, south of Ratchet. It is called Fray Island and it is a place where warriors meet.
rows.quest:1718:details:3: BSpeak with the chief warrior of Fray Island, Klannoc Macleod. If he finds you worthy, then Klannoc will lead you further down the warrior's path.
rows.quest:1718:details:4: BTo reach Fray Island, search for the sand bar shallows along the Merchant Coast.
rows.quest:1718:completion:0: Hello, ⟦29⟧. It's good to see you made it to Fray Island. I hope you find it to your liking...
rows.quest:1719:obj:0: Kill Big Will, then speak to Klannoc Macleod on Fray Island.
rows.quest:1719:details:0: If you want to learn from me, then you must first pass The Affray. It is a challenge we on Fray Island like to offer rising warriors who think they're tough, and if you can pass this test then I'll know you are.
rows.quest:1719:details:1: BTo begin, walk into the middle of that crowd yonder and step on the grate. That'll tell Twiggy Flathead you're ready, and he'll send challengers against you.
rows.quest:1719:details:2: BBeat all the challengers and he'll call out Big Will. Kill Big Will, and return to me in the time we allow.
rows.quest:1719:completion:0: Well done, ⟦30⟧. You have passed The Affray!
rows.quest:1719:completion:1: BYou are a worthy warrior, and I am honored to teach you...
rows.quest:1782:completion:0: Here's your armor, ⟦31⟧. This will stand up to the strongest assaults or my name isn't Furen Longbeard!
rows.quest:1782:completion:1: BAnd I have to thank you. I learned a lot while working with the materials⟦32⟧you brought me. I think I'll have another breakthrough one day!
rows.quest:1782:completion:2: BI'm going to send what I learned to other⟦33⟧blacksmiths of the ⟦E15⟧.
rows.quest:1782:completion:3: BI'll tell them you were a big help, and maybe they'll want to return the favor.
rows.quest:1791:details:0: Now that you've learned your berserker's stance, you'll want a nice weapon to use it with.
rows.quest:1791:details:1: BTalk to Bath'rah the Windwatcher, a troll hermit who lives between the ⟦E21⟧ and the ⟦E22⟧. He is a skilled weapon maker and a powerful shaman.
rows.quest:1791:details:2: BTo find Bath'rah, go to the river that flows along Tarren Mill's eastern flank. Follow it north--Bath'rah is camped near ruins that rest along the river's eastern bank.
rows.quest:1791:completion:0: You have traveled far, young warrior. I see fire in your eyes. You seek a weapon of great power, yes?
rows.quest:1791:completion:1: BI can help you with your quest. And you can help me with mine.
rows.quest:1792:completion:0: I have the whirlwind heart, and am ready to place it within your vessel of choice.
rows.quest:1792:completion:1: BChoose your weapon, ⟦34⟧, and know that its power is the power of Cyclonian.
